task_meta.title: Add cursor paging to a list endpoint

claim_text:
I added cursor paging to `handleListTickets` in `src/handler.ts`, and all 10 tests pass, including the "second page" test that was failing before.

**How it works**
- **Cursor contents:** the cursor holds the sort key of the last ticket on the page (`createdAt` plus `id`), not it
digest: Read 9 files (9 before its first edit), made 1 edit, ran tests 4 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
